name: week
title: The rental week
subtitle: Fictional demo unless your records have been imported.

sections.title: Pickups and returns
sections.sql: SELECT ref,plate,driver,status,pickup_at,return_due,pickup_location,return_location FROM rental_board ORDER BY pickup_at

sections.title: Decisions due
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM attention_queue ORDER BY issue,ref

sections.title: Certificate and service clocks
sections.sql: SELECT plate,model,location,status,inspection_expires,registration_expires,service_due,blockers FROM fleet_readiness ORDER BY plate

sections.title: Agreed charges and recorded payments
sections.note: Estimate only. Whole 24-hour periods, rounded up. Tax treatment follows the entered rate. No payments are processed.
sections.sql: SELECT ref,driver,status,currency,total_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents FROM rental_board WHERE status!='cancelled' ORDER BY ref
